facts.text: The detectives who won't let it go.
facts.why: Sing is dead by the present day and Tapp is the only detective still chasing Jigsaw, so the plural is off.
facts.fix: The detective who won't let it go.

vibe.verdict: Right bathroom and the right badge idea, but the clean blue lab look and plain snack names miss how grimy and tense the film is.
missing: Hacksaws in the toilet cistern bag (Adam finds them)
Reverse bear trap in Amanda's game (flashback)
Two cigarettes, a lighter and the one-way cell phone in the box
Billy the puppet rolling up on his tricycle to congratulate Amanda
Zep and the pig mask in the parking garage
The key that went down the bathtub drain
ideas: Swap the note 'The puzzles in every trap' on the cheddar crackers for 'Hacksaw breadsticks, in a bag from the toilet cistern'.
Swap 'Red velvet cupcakes' for 'Last cigarette cupcakes' with a lighter candle, using the two cigarettes in the box.
Change the clean blue and white paper to dirty green tile with grime so it feels like the bathroom.
Replace the note on 'Red cream soda over ice' with Billy rolling in on his tricycle.
